summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an adjustment to the exercise price of its equity-linked securities and call spread following the declaration of a $0.0941 per share final dividend for FY2025. The equity-linked securities exercise price was reduced from $8.0314 to $7.8525 per share, and the aggregate number of cash-settled shares increased from 68,481,979 to 70,042,085. The upper strike warrant exercise price was also adjusted from $12.7340 to $12.4503. This is a routine contractual adjustment for existing securities, not a special situation event. No action for holders; watch for no further unusual activity.
